Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 3rd last 8 Lengths 600m 3 Wide 8th 7 Lengths Straightened Up Hard Ridden last no run on Straight # back/never in it

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55.5kg. Began awkwardly. Passing the 600m became awkwardly placed and had to be checked from the heels of horse when attempting to improve into the race. Rider was told to exercise greater care when attempting to improve into a position where there was insufficient room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same until improving 3 Wide @ 550m & Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed out Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & ran on soundly Five Wide in last 150m. # Good from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55.5kg. Passing the 900m was restrained from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down Inside 4th, 3.5 Lengths @ 750m. came off rail To The Turn . angled into Clear 300m. Ridden Along but couldn't quicken as required # given Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1kg over the allotted weight 55kg. Passing the 900m was hampered by a runner which was carried in by another runner. Approaching the home-turn was steadied when awkwardly placed on the heels of a runner.
